account: It is day 0, about 09:00. I have come from home to town hall, read the secretary's appointment book, and returned it to its chest. Today appears routine so far: correspondence this morning, a plaza market walk at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with a neighbour in a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I asked the secretary about correspondence, urgent business, and which cottage hosts tea, but have not yet heard a reply. The secretary is nearby holding a writable book. The builder has approached and is carrying a lantern; I do not know why, and have no evidence that this is unusual or connected to any particular work. Several townsfolk have passed or gathered near the hall's road point. I have heard no news or reports of trouble, so I cannot identify any unusual town activity or its purpose.
